positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Firmware and compilers for accelerator hardware.

positions.title: Quantum Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on open source PennyLane development. Added JAX integration and helped develop the first generation of pennylane.transforms.

positions.title: Google Brain Research Intern
positions.description: Worked on machine learning robotics team. Focused on implementation and in depth analysis of Progressive Neural Networks for transfer learning. Also helped implement reinforcement learning architecture.

positions.title: Super Computing Undergraduate Research
positions.description:
Helped create experimental automatic differentiation C++ data type. This data type can calculate and order partial derivative of a function simply by switching all float types to AD. 

The code can be found here:
https://github.com/SCOREC/core/blob/master/mth/mthAD.h

positions.title: Intern Software Developer and Analyst
positions.description: Was a member of the graphics team. Worked on shader meta program implementation. Decreased shader build time from several minutes to a few seconds with dynamic compilation. Also added features to our 2D Geometry API, focusing on efficient elliptical and Bezier curves rendering.
